name: World Ender: granted attack damage
objective: Investigate high World Ender attack-damage increase output with a finite setup; compare controlled item swaps rather than claiming a global maximum.
mechanic: R grants 20/30/40% attack damage during its duration. The selected number is actual AD gained from one activation, measured before and after, not damage from a nonexistent impact. Its self-healing increase and movement speed are different outputs; do not feed the granted AD back into itself indefinitely.
finiteState: Level 18, selected ability maximum learned rank unless explicitly overridden, minute 30. Reference enemy (not the recipient of this self effect): 3000 maximum HP, 100 armor and 50 MR. Owner HP 30%, target HP 100%, observation 3s. No dragons, elixirs or allied stat buffs. Record actual AD/AP, HP and resist modifiers; Gathering Storm at minute 30 if selected. No free permanent stacks. Stop damage at death, cap healing at recipient missing HP, and report raw output separately. Exactly 10 earned Hubris kills with temporary buff, 500 earned Heartsteel HP, owner 30% and 12 earned Conqueror stacks. Record actual health-dependent Bloodmail AD and total AD immediately before R, then immediately after rank-3 activation. No takedowns, healing or damage changing HP during the measurement.
test: Swap HP/Bloodmail versus raw AD at fixed owner HP percentage. Compare temporary buffs active/inactive as separate setups, recording the actual R gain each time. Observe expiry independently of damage or healing; no repeated activations within the same buff.
